// Wrapper over the generated client. No handwritten types: every alias below
// is an indexed access off the generated index, which is what the guard's
// frontend-type-drift rule requires.

export type TemplateDTO = components["schemas"]["Template"];

export const signoffVersion = () => BASE;
export const putTemplateSchemas = () => BASE;
